verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a public library of Zap or workflow templates that an ops user could start from. MCP tool bundles (zapier-docs-30) are shareable lists of MCP server tools, not workflow templates, so they are adjacent and earn no credit. The community comment about integration pages (zapier-comm-7) does not describe a template library either.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can start from a public library of workflow templates instead of building from scratch
